summary: Iter58 verified 3 user-requested fixes: (1) OpenRouter key at-rest encryption, (2) onboarding folder-picker + storage-root wiring + Settings display, (3) mail context menu on iframe email body. Backend: 6/6 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter58_encryption.py — provider.json contains only apiKeyEnc (aes-256-gcm iv:tag:ct base64), GET /ai-api/ai/provider exposes hasKey/keyHint/ready without leaking apiKey, live OpenRouter /models returns 430+ models, storage-root GET works, and — most importantly — legacy migration works: injecting a legacy plaintext apiKey into provider.json and calling GET auto-reseals the file to apiKeyEnc within <5s (verified end-to-end). Frontend: onboarding pick-folder end-to-end works (step1 model-connected → step2 PIN 6-digit → recovery-code → step3 onb-pick-folder opens folder-picker; fp-confirm sets storage-root; onboarding completes and Library opens). Settings → «Общее облако» shows the exact path in [data-testid=cloud-storage-path] (verified '/root'). Physical file write to picked folder confirmed via direct API: PUT storage-root=/tmp/wsx-iter58 → POST /ai-api/cloud/upload → file physically written to /tmp/wsx-iter58/iter58payload.txt (28 bytes, mode 0600). Mail context menu: mailbox + message load fine in UI, iframe (about:srcdoc) renders CTA button/text/image correctly, but real page.mouse right-click at computed CTA/text/image coordinates did NOT open [data-testid=mail-ctx-menu] — 0 items detected, no console errors. Escape and outside-click checks return true trivially (menu was never open). This is either a headless-Chromium-only issue with right-click on about:srcdoc frames OR a real regression in the BRIDGE postMessage flow in components/mail/mail-msg-view.tsx that should be verified manually in a real browser.

ui_bugs.issue: Right-click on CTA button, selected text, and image inside the email iframe did NOT open [data-testid=mail-ctx-menu] in headless Playwright — 0 mail-ctx-* items detected after real page.mouse.click(button='right') at computed iframe→page coords. May be a headless-only limitation with contextmenu on about:srcdoc, or the BRIDGE postMessage('ctx', ...) is not being received by the parent. Needs manual verification in a real browser and/or console instrumentation.

rca of the issue: Mail context menu not triggering under headless Playwright: components/mail/mail-msg-view.tsx renders email body in a srcdoc iframe with an in-iframe BRIDGE that listens to contextmenu, preventDefault()'s it, and postMessage's a 'ctx' object to the parent. The parent's message listener then opens the custom menu at the reported client coords. Under headless page.mouse.click(button='right') at proper iframe→page coordinates, either (a) the contextmenu event reaches the iframe DOM but the BRIDGE listener isn't installed by the time the click happens (race between iframe srcdoc load and message-passing setup), or (b) postMessage from about:srcdoc is not fully propagating in headless. No console errors observed. Since iter57 also could not trigger any custom context menu in headless (library cards), the headless-only-limitation theory is likely, but it MUST be manually verified before closing.
